items.title: Accelerating GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast
items.whyItMatters: OpenAI running GPT-5.6 on Cerebras SiX chips — real data on inference throughput at the model frontier, not synthetic benchmarks.

items.title: Google is making private AI practical with homomorphic encryption
items.whyItMatters: Practical homomorphic encryption for ML inference — running models on encrypted data without decrypting first, moving from theory to shipped.

items.title: Choosing an AI model: one prompt, 11 models, different results
items.whyItMatters: One prompt across 11 models shows real output divergence — useful reality check when benchmarking or selecting a model for a task.

items.title: Text AI watermarks will always be trivial to remove
items.whyItMatters: Demonstrates that AI text watermarks are trivially breakable — important signal for anyone building content provenance or copyright systems.

items.title: AI At Home Part 1: A Box Of Scraps
items.whyItMatters: Hands-on local AI build from scrap hardware — practical notes on what runs, what doesn't, and the real cost/performance trade-offs of home inference.
